candidate.memory_scope: Summed sampled RSS of training process and monitor; shared pages can be counted twice and sub-sample peaks missed; no kernel allocation cap.
candidate.resource_scope: Training process plus external monitor. Four search workers, four tensor threads and two coordinators: 10 conservative cores.

historical.memory_scope: Summed sampled RSS of training process and monitor; shared pages can be counted twice and sub-sample peaks missed; no kernel allocation cap.
historical.resource_scope: Training process plus external monitor. Four search workers, four tensor threads and two coordinators:10 conservative cores.

eight_game_learning_pilot.scope: Eight one-round curriculum games, not eight July1941 campaigns. New interface changes actual games, targets, model weights and optimizer trajectories; elapsed difference is not an implementation-only speed comparison. No learning-strength evaluation.

verification.scope: Same-version replay of actual chosen actions/dice only, with all eight real terminal outcomes and retained training rows checked. No neural search or optimizer rerun; no equality of post-training weights or trajectories with the old interface.

guard_extension.scope: Same-interface guard extension only. Preserves the primary guarded result; not a speedup against an unfinished batch.

legacy_compatibility.scope: Legacy action replay/export only, source drift explicitly allowed. Every old search menu/payload and selected action/state+execution RNG hash remains authoritative. No neural search, training, budget change or drift suppression.

resource_and_measurement_notes.coverage_limit: Observed extended games exercised 6/6 committed routes,7 canonical force additions,7 role/deck configuration changes. No screening addition was observed; screening/legal subset coverage comes from focused native tests. Raw legacy rules remain accessible.
resource_and_measurement_notes.overlap: At most one parent profiling core overlapped candidate full11/primary collection; at most one replay core plus one light parent core overlapped extended collection. Four final replay verifier processes ran after benchmark/training ended. All activity stayed within the 12-core allocation.
resource_and_measurement_notes.peak_scope: RSS is sampled process-group RSS per invocation, not instantaneous total across all task activities. Shared pages can be counted twice and brief peaks can be missed. External 0.1s monitor with 128MiB margin; no kernel memory cap.
resource_and_measurement_notes.repeat_scope: Single matched numerical workload per case on one machine; no confidence interval. Primary240s 0/4 remains unchanged. Extended600s completion is separate evidence, not a speedup against an unfinished batch.

scope: Changed campaign action interface and search tree, with unchanged approved rule setup. Same numerical budgets and frozen transferred inference weights where reported. Actual eight-game learning is separately identified. No pure implementation speedup, cross-interface trajectory/learning equality, or playing-strength claim.
